alex: heads-up: last night we saw ~2x jump in per-token p99 for route `chat-stream` around 02:12 UTC. suspect kernel-selection fallback + KV cold misses. anyone watching perf dashboards?

miriam: on it. i pushed a quick panel to perf-kpis: https://dashboards.redwood.dev/d/infra/per-token-kernel-breakdown :eyes:

chen: ran a profile at ts=1951234600 — flame graph points to aten::matmul switching to generic kernel when seq_len > 1024. uploaded raw profile: s3://redwood-perf/profiles/1951234600/flame.svg

sophie: kv hit-rate dipped ~98% -> 71% at same window. logs show repeated `kv_cache_eviction: triggered` from node-gang-3. looks like TTL eviction during a rebalance.

alex: can we get token-level breakdown by kernel + kv_hit? need per-route cost delta. here's the SQL i used to compute usd/token (local run):

```sql
SELECT route, kernel_name AS kernel, kv_hit, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, ROUND(SUM(cost_usd)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(tokens),0), 8) AS usd_per_token
FROM token_accounting.v1
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-17T00:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-18T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY route, kernel_name, kv_hit
ORDER BY route, usd_per_token DESC;
```

miriam: nice. i'll add `kernel_name` and `kv_hit` as tags on token telemetry and enable a 1/100 sample of full traces (to keep cardinality sane) — PR-432 inbound.

infra-bot: deploy started: perf-instrumentation/PR-432 -> staging at 1951234700

chen: after applying the kernel-heuristic tweak from PR-432 p99 latency dropped ~30% for chat-stream, but total cost_per_1k_tokens increased ~7% due to slightly larger batch expansion during steady state. tradeoff to review.

sophie: proposal: add a route-level KPI `cost_per_1k_tokens` (USD) and alert when > baseline * 1.20 for > 5m. also bake in `kv_eviction_rate` and `kernel_change_rate` on the same panel.

alex: action items:
- miriam: add kernel tag + dashboard panels (kernel_name, kv_hit, batch_size distribution, kv_eviction_rate)
- chen: compute per-route delta table (before/after PR-432) and write micro-postmortem GH#2987
- ops (@sophie): create alert for cost_per_1k_tokens > 1.2x baseline for 5m
- alex: schedule 15m sync tomorrow to agree on SLA tradeoffs

deploy-bot: staging -> prod rollout started at 1951234880 :rocket:

sophie: quick notes for dashboard: include KV eviction heatmap by node, TTL distribution, and model seq_len percentiles (p50/p90/p99) — that explains why matmul fell back.

alex: thanks. filing follow-up issue: GH#2987 (perf-instr: per-route kernel+kv cost view). :thumbsup:

miriam: will post screenshots of the new panels in this thread once prod rollout completes. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
